title: CAM Assist Risk Assessment Schema
description: Portable record of known manufacturing risks for a strategy package. A sidecar artifact that travels alongside a package without mutating it. Risk scoring is informational only; it grants no execution authority and does not gate execution.

record_version.description: Semantic version of the risk assessment record format

package_reference.description: Reference to the package being assessed. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this risk assessment was created

overall_risk.description: Overall informational risk level for the package

risks.description: List of identified manufacturing risks. Informational only.

category.description: Free-text category (e.g., geometry, tooling, material, fixturing, safety)

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. When present, every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.
